title.en: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES PLACING THE NATIONAL PRINTING OFFICE AND ASIAN PRODUCTIVITY ORGANIZATION (APO) PRODUCTION UNIT UNDER THE PHILIPPINE INFORMATION AGENCY
title.orig: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES PLACING THE NATIONAL PRINTING OFFICE AND ASIAN PRODUCTIVITY ORGANIZATION (APO) PRODUCTION UNIT UNDER THE PHILIPPINE INFORMATION AGENCY

text.en:
The National Printing Office and Asian Productivity Organization
(APO) Production Unit are hereby placed under the Philippine Information Agency.

This Executive Order shall take effect: immediateiy.
Done in the City of Manila, this 12thday of March in the year of Our Lord,
Two Thousand and Ten.
By the President:
Executive Secretary
PGMA Hologram • 55374
